§6Rocket Seat§f goes at the top of every AR rocket. It defines passenger capacity, control surface, and inventory that the pilot uses during flight.

Craft it: 1 Wool (any color for the cushion) + 1 Steel Plate. Each rocket needs at least one Seat to be considered valid by the Rocket Assembling Machine. You can place up to six seats for a multiplayer crew.

The seat stores inventory items for the pilot, oxygen, food, and tools are drawn from the seat's slot during flight.

§cWARNING:§f Place the seat at the highest Y level of the rocket frame. The assembler rejects rockets where the seat is buried inside the structure rather than on top.

§ePS:§f Without a seat, the assembler flags the rocket as 'unmanned' and it can only be flown by an Unmanned Vehicle Assembler.
